chunks: Indeed, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Every possessor of fangs from the predatory animals and (every possessor of) claws from the birds is forbidden.' And he (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not eat anything from the predators.'

key_terms.السِّبَاعِ: Predatory animals, beasts of prey — land animals that hunt with fangs
key_terms.الطَّيْرِ: Birds or fowl — in this context referring to birds of prey with talons
key_terms.حَرَامٌ: Forbidden, prohibited — the legal ruling (hukm) of impermissibility in Islamic jurisprudence
key_terms.مِخْلَبٍ: Claw or talon — the distinguishing feature of birds of prey that makes them haram
key_terms.نَابٍ: Fang or canine tooth — the distinguishing feature of predatory land animals that makes them haram

ai.seo_question: Which animals are forbidden to eat according to the Prophet's hadith about fangs and claws?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) reports a ruling from the Prophet (SAWW) that all fanged predatory animals and clawed birds are forbidden (haram) to eat. The Imam then adds a complementary prohibition: do not eat anything at all from predatory animals. This hadith establishes a comprehensive rule in Islamic dietary law distinguishing permitted animals from those with predatory characteristics such as fangs and talons.
